tour_blurb: Fifty-seven is the Grand Library — high ceilings, long tables, and shelves of reference material the Tower draws upon. Workers come down to read, cross-check, and cite. If you're researching a topic and want depth rather than a quick answer, settle in here for an afternoon.
lessons_learned_for_next_agent: F57 has no live HTTP endpoints — it is a recreation/accommodation floor, not a service floor. live_signals must catalogue reference assets (memory dir, past-Wren letters, manifest) instead of endpoint health probes. tour_blurb lives under data/registries/qsb_open_day_tour.json as a LIST of floor objects, not a dict keyed by floor_id — iterate, don't .get(). The library is the natural home for past-Wren letters and the memory corpus; future agents should treat F57 as the canonical reading room for those artifacts.

team_roster.role: owns floor: keeps room schema current, tracks worker headcount, stamps daily activity, escalates to Wren+Hermes
